conclusion: Se evita reconstruir el historial sin cambios y copiarlo por completo para buscar. Los resultados medidos corresponden a memoria externa explícita, no a conversación ni aprendizaje de parámetros.

implementation.authoritativeSource: Existing events.jsonl; cache is process-local and disposable
implementation.cacheHitVerification: SHA-256 of all bytes currently in events.jsonl
implementation.complexity: Reads/hashing remain O(current log bytes), with status/list/search traversal dependent on records; no O(1) claim
implementation.isolation: Existing workspace-root locks plus a separate process-wide cache LRU guard
implementation.publicationRule: Evict before applying append; reinsert only after successful complete write and fsync
implementation.queryNormalization: NFC per original Unicode word, then casefold; Mn/Mc/Me remain inside word spans. Accents and original source offsets/SHA are preserved.

retrieval.unicode: NFC por palabra para comparar; se conservan acentos y offsets de caracteres del texto original.

fixture.origin: Authored deterministic fictional events only; no creator memory or model outputs

benchmark.aggregation: Median of three per-run medians; each operation warmed three times, except appends warm status before each trial
benchmark.comparison: Three alternating baseline/optimized subprocess pairs under the same period of background-worker activity

retrieval.attribution: Combined replay reuse plus avoiding deepcopy of the whole history; not an isolated measure of either component
retrieval.baselineRoute: Validated full detached workspace.show snapshot, then identical lexical helper
retrieval.optimizedRoute: workspace.search_tasks under one workspace lock/load; only bounded matching output copied
retrieval.outputParity: Asserted exact JSON equality with the full detached snapshot route in every subprocess

limitations: Background load is not controlled or constant; alternating trials reduce but do not eliminate timing confounds.
These are warmed synthetic local-log timings on this machine, not general latency, model-learning or quality guarantees.
Measurements do not include cold first replay, logs above the eligibility bound, peak RSS, remote storage or production workloads.
Earlier before.json/after.json, alternating-v1 reports and receipt.json are preserved historical studies; only the unicode-v2 alternating reports measure this final helper/public script.

coveredInvariants: Complete current-byte SHA check on cache hit; same-size rewrite with restored mtime is detected.
Malformed history is rejected without resetting or replacing original bytes.
Write failure, partial write and fsync failure invalidate cached mutable state; next read reconstructs real bytes.
Cross-process latest rejection overrides previously accepted feedback and prevents export.
Public snapshots and search results are detached from internal state.
Cache eviction/bypass bounds, parallel roots and existing same-root concurrent writes preserve isolation.
Search validates before filesystem access and loads once under the existing workspace lock.
workspaceTests.workspaceSuiteAttribution: 21/21 previously observed on the unchanged workspace/cache source and unchanged test file; final Unicode helper suites are attributed separately to their author receipt.

retrievalTests.scope: Lexical helper and Brain/CLI/HTTP with model execution disabled; includes Unicode equivalence, original offsets, isolation, latest feedback and bounds.

selectedBrainCliHttpRegressions.scope: Existing transport and memory behavior, separately reported; these counts are not summed as a unique total.

limitations: La caché valida todos los bytes actuales; el hash mantiene coste lineal. El límite de 2 MiB se refiere al historial elegible, no al consumo exacto de RAM.
La recuperación exige las palabras indicadas y sólo consulta registros de su ámbito. No interpreta sinónimos ni decide si un contexto inicial quedó obsoleto: devuelve su fuente literal.
Las referencias externas se conservan, sin abrirlas ni validar su contenido.
Las mediciones anteriores al arreglo Unicode quedan archivadas y no describen esta versión final.
